decisions.reason: As a peripheral but likely low-cost ecosystem initiative, the accelerator still offers partnership and deal-flow option value, though its distance from the core machinery business keeps exit risk relatively high.

The CO2-negative binder remains worth keeping because of its flagship status and circular-economy fit, but its more adjacent position to the core equipment business means the firm would drop it sooner than core machinery options if traction stays unclear.

The infectious-waste decontamination plant is close to the established offer and was highlighted as a strategic focus, so in a growing and innovative firm it remains a strong option to retain while market uncertainty continues to resolve.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant sits squarely within the firm’s modular recycling capabilities and supports decentralized deployment, making it the kind of core-adjacent option management would be least likely to abandon quickly.
